svg.title: CyberFinger controls in Cyberpunk VR
svg.desc: Numbered original left and right controller illustrations with context-specific controls. Left-handed weapon preset.
svg.text: Gameplay | Left-handed weapon preset | Full-forward sprint
Move. Hold fully forward 0.2 s to sprint. Click and release to jump.
Scanner on foot. Hold in vehicle: exit.
Tap: next weapon. Hold: weapon wheel.
Turn. Up/down for dash/crouch. Click to jump, hold to charge.
Eat / use at prompts. Rack a gun or toggle fists / melee weapon.
Hold left stick click and push right stick for the D-pad. Hold both Menu buttons to toggle HUD. Close fingers near an object to grab.
Black wrist buttons follow weapon hand: eject / pause on the weapon side, quick reload / heal on the other.
